levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن المسور، الزهري

notes: «كلاهما عن ابن عيينة» then «حدثنا سفيان»: the same man written twice in succession (rule 7), so one link; the fuller form is kept
«- واللفظ للزهري -» is an editor gloss and is left out
the story of Ka'b b. al-Ashraf's killing is told in the scene; Jabir is the last link since he is the one heard («سمعت جابرا»)
